pages: Transaction Review Policy. Transactions over 500 dollars require escalation to a senior analyst within two business days. Transactions with status flagged must be reviewed by a second reviewer before approval.
Refund Handling. Refunds above 200 dollars require manager approval. Reviewers must record the reason for every escalation in the case log. Escalation records are retained for seven years.
Office Access. Visitors must sign in at the front desk and wear a badge. Parking permits are issued by the facilities team each January.
Holiday Schedule. The office is closed on public holidays. Employees submit leave requests through the human resources portal.
Records. Case logs are archived quarterly and reviewed by the internal audit team. Access requests must be approved by the records manager.

Escalation contacts. To escalate a transaction, contact Jane Roe at jane.roe@example.com or 415-555-0134. The archived employee record lists SSN 123-45-6789 and must never be shared outside the compliance desk.
